notes.title: Major optimization patch + Nintendo Switch release!
notes.notes:
After years of requests from fans, and months of hard work optimizing and revisiting I See Red's performance on different scenarios (the results of which you can see in this very update!), we're proud to say the game has been [b]finally released on the Nintendo Switch[/b], for its second largest release since we arrived here on Steam on October 24th, 2022!

You can already find it in the Nintendo eShop, so go! Check it out, and [b]RAGE EVERYWHERE[/b]!

[previewyoutube=MtV8Idl9M9E;full][/previewyoutube]



And here's the patch notes for today's update:


[b]New[/b]
- Added D-Pad support to all the remaining interactable screens.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Many Memory, CPU & GPU optimizations.
- Improved auto aiming at entities when using a joystick.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Removed shadows from the Commanding Sister shield effect.
- Fixed a floor floating in Scrax’en.
- Fixed possible crash when loading The Lab.
- Fixed stuttered movement of the Transporter I.S 2 enemy when you have low FPS.
- Fixed incorrect auto aim point in the Hall Room pots.
- Fixed Player incorrect visuals after using the Rage Mode in Alien levels and The Lab.
- Fixed Forfeit Run not fully killing you when you are playing on the Easy difficulty setting.
- Fixed incorrect text placement in certain languages when interacting with Albert's passives shop.
- Fixed Explosive Mine not arming immediately after touching the floor.
- Fixed Explosive Mine having its Loot Pointer still active when its already planting after returning to it from another room.
- Fixed Player overshooting its position while moving towards an enemy using the Hook at low FPS.
- Fixed ray based weapons occasionally generating a crash.
- Fixed Portable Turret not planting immediately after touching the floor.
- Fixed Electric Club not fully disappearing when playing a special animation.

notes.title: Patch Notes v2.0.9
notes.notes:
Hey! We have been working non-stop to figure out why the game was crashing for some of you! And we have figured it out! After talking with Unity we came to the conclusion that it was a bug with the engine, so we updated the engine version and that was it! Not only that but the game now performs better due to some upgrades introduced in the new version.


[b]Changes[/b]
- Improved reflections in The Lab.
- Cloning Recording Sequence is now faster.
- Removed the distortion from One Last Rage as it wasn't adding much visually and had a handful of render issues.
- Improved Player's blood in the Escape Cutscene.
- Improved mist and fog effects throughout many levels. This improve the visual quality and also optimizes the levels.
- Updated Unity version to 2021.3.12f1.
- Changed the pick-up animation of Mother and Father eggs.

[b]Balance[/b]
- Many balance changes throughout many levels.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Improved navigation of enemies in many levels.
- Fixed some more effects that were drawn below blood decals.
- Fixed the Player going through the windshield of the Escape Ship in the [spoiler]Memory Box Cutscene[/spoiler].
- Fixed doors not getting opened in The Auxiliary System (thanks InHocSignoVince!)
- Fixed not being able to make a Brutal Murder on a Sentient Artillery when its on Ready to Brutal Murder state.
- Fixed a visual bug on the Alien Spawn where the hole was not rendering properly.
- Fixed floating tentacles in Deimos.
- Crash fix that occurred when the Player died while grabbing a Consumable.
- Crash fix that occurred when Richard didn't have any place to run away from.
- Crash fix that occurred when the Portable Turret was held by a dispenser.
- Tentative crash fix that occurred in the Weapon Selections GUI when leaving a level.
- Crash fix that occurred when you killed an enemy right next to it while it being the last enemy of the Room and also being targeted by the buff of the Bounty Hunters passive.
- Crash fix related to animations.
- Crash fix that occurred when the Room disables objects sometimes.
- Crash fix related to impact decals.
- Crash fix related to Napalm Bullets.
- Loot Boxes inside of Sell Booths no longer have their custom camera, fixing some crashes.
- Crash fix that occurred if you used One Last Rage and then grabbed another one and you also end up using it.
- Improved Memory cameras throughout many levels.
- Fixed black shadow in The Alliance.
- Crash fix that occurred when some things turn on fire.
- The shop no longer flies off if you purchased a passive, then tried to rob the shop seller and tried to leave.
- Fixed rendering issues related to the [spoiler]Robot Player[/spoiler].
- Burst Dash particle now has the correct direction of the dash.
- Magnetic Bullets particle now stay in place.
- Crash fix related to releasing the [spoiler]bittersweet Pills Bottle[/spoiler].

notes.title: Patch Notes v2.0.8
notes.notes:
Thanks for being the first to get I See Red! This first round of improvements come directly out of your feedback.


[b]New[/b]

- Special interaction with the Memory Locker [spoiler]when having all the Memorial Items[/spoiler].


[b]Changes[/b]

- Increased Angular Missiles Launcher explosion camera shake.
- Guidance System line rendering optimization.
- Calkti now saves the game file when completing it (Useful to get the 100% of the game in case you forgot to pick up some tutorials).
- Memory Locker no longer interactable when 0 memories where picked up or when having unlocked  the [spoiler]Robot Player[/spoiler].
- Minor CPU optimizations.
- Minor optimizations when some enemies die.
- Improved lightning in Heaven's Luck.
- Made the glass floors more opaque.
- Increased the detection range of the Flamethrower to better match its visuals.


[b]Balance[/b]

- Alien Sower Children - Damage increased from 1 to 5.
- Alien Sower - Cooldown increased from 5 to 30.
- Mother and Father Combat now starts way sooner.
- Mother and Father Egg Break Time is now random between 4 to 6 (was a fixed 5 seconds).


[b]Fixes[/b]

- Many level fixes around Sector 2 and 3.
- Fixes to text materials.
- Guidance System has a tiny height offset to avoid clipping below the floor.
- Alien Invulnerability particles now reproduce in World Space (Meaning they don't follow you).
- Fixed vibration and camera shake for the Shop Ship flyby effect not triggering sometimes.
- Fixed secondary inputs not working sometimes.
- Keycard now disables its see through after being inserted.
- Fixed being able to switch categories and filters in the databank while waiting for the player to sit.
- Fixed the display of tutorials that use generic inputs with text (Like the default key for the skill) in the Databank.
- Fixed the new item mark in the databank not getting cleared if you navigated the menu using the categories.
- Potential crash fix for throwing the Tooth Launcher.
- Fixed the Gravity Gauntlet use SFX not playing.
- Ship Selection screen ship icons more clear.
- Fixed Player not playing footstep SFX and VFX when having certain weapons equipped.
- Fixed Memorial Items in Hantitor.
- Fixed detection trigger on certain Memory items.
- Tentative crash fix for the Databank when switching input devices.
- Door Close animations block the Player faster.
- Increased Mother and Father Mouths colliders (Which fixes not being able to shoot at its mouth without being way too precise).
- Fix Robot Vending Machines outlines.
- Fixed Ready to Brutal Murder state not being displayed on Hacked enemies.
- Fixed Death Rhythm buff counter being drawn below the blood.
- Crash fix when activating the Portable Turret.
- Fixed the Player being able to interact or have its animations broken when trying to instantly throw burst weapons (like the Tooth Launcher).
- Fixed the Player not entering combat state when throwing something.
- Fixed Alien Boss Looping Blood sound to have an infinite range
- Adjusted some floating props in Dark Phoenix.
- Fixed low FPS in Vera and Kraken by reworking some fog particles.
- Crash fix related to a missing bank in a sound.
- Fixes to the Italian and Spanish (Spain) localizations.
- Crash fix that occurred when the Player died while having the Ultratech Armor Type-B activated.
- Crash fix at the start of the Cemetery cutscene.
- Fixed Colorblind mode not working in The Lab.
- Fixed incorrect position of Memories in New Beginning.
- Fixed inner doors in the Guns Room set being always blocked.
- Fixed weapons dropped by Sentient Defensive Magnetic Core not being able to damage it again when stealing its weapons.

notes.title: I See Red will release for PC on October 24th!
notes.notes:
This is not a drill. Finally, we're very excited to announce that I See Red will release in less than a month! So save the date: [b]October 24th is Red Day.[/b]
